result.summary: The UI appears largely functional, but there is a visual inconsistency regarding text truncation and potential clipping in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated with an ellipsis in the 'Fastest near you' section, making it hard to identify the full name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout to allow for longer names or use dynamic font scaling so the full restaurant name is visible.

issues.description: The bottom card showing a pizza is cut off at the very bottom of the screen, indicating a potential issue with padding or scroll area management.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding to the main scroll container to ensure the last card is fully visible without requiring the user to scroll past the bottom edge of the viewport.
